narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Fifteen is fifteen ones, so draw fifteen triangles.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Five triangles always become one square in this system.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>A long row of triangles breaks that rule, so it must be regrouped.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows fifteen triangles in a row; five of them merge into a square; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>To check, add up the values of the shapes you drew.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Two circles, one hexagon, three squares and three triangles give two hundred fifty, twenty five, fifteen and three.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>That makes two hundred ninety three, and no shape should ever appear five times.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor and the answer card; check lines appear: add the values of the shapes; no shape five times

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu wants to draw fifteen triangles for fifteen. Five triangles always become one square, so fifteen triangles must be regrouped.
